notes.title: 🚨B-PROJECT RYUSEI*FANTASIA IS OUT NOW🚨
notes.notes:
B-PROJECT RYUSEI*FANTASIA IS FINALLY HERE! Watch the trailer below for a sneak peak at the gameplay👇[previewyoutube=JKBnqUFpies;full][/previewyoutube]

All 14 boys are eagerly awaiting your guidance as their Artist & Repertoire (A&R)! Dive in and become their guiding light in this captivating visual novel full of beautiful, heart-throbbing boys! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44900598/ba88c571b94400378538df524c121221f85d687f.jpg[/img]

This extraordinary idol group  'B-project' is made up of four dynamic sub-groups: KITAKORE, THRIVE, MooNs, and KiLLER KiNG.

You get to message the boys on your smartphone, build relationships, and unlock incredible their music.
Consider yourself a player and a fan!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44900598/981f8d4db0e39d36569e4aafb39cbb1a70bbf2c6.jpg[/img]

Don't forget you can check out the demo for a preview of the game, and don't miss out on the 10% launch discount!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44900598/87223dd9572ba6580201a188bab4dd2c884e2abf.jpg[/img]

notes.title: B-PROJECT RYUSEI*FANTASIA! COMING SOON!
notes.notes:
[previewyoutube=xBswxMB6Tqw;full][/previewyoutube]
We are thrilled to announce the arrival of B-PROJECT RYUSEI*FANTASIA! 

Immerse yourself in this captivating visual novel filled with a diverse cast of idols and thrilling experiences, where you take on the role of A&R (Artist & Repertoire)!

As the representative of the special group 'B-project,' your mission is to guide all 14 boys towards achieving their utmost potential as idols. 

This unique idol group comprises four male sub-groups: KITAKORE, THRIVE, MooNs and KiLLER KiNG. With the aid of a smartphone device, you can actively engage with the boys, creating meaningful relationships that contribute to their growth. You can also sit and enjoy the music you unlock through the music section, as both a player and a fan! Get your heart ready for exclusive performances, exceptional music and stunning visuals in this unforgettable visual novel!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44900598/eb68e6f269ee10680befac8dfadd5f5815202475.gif[/img]
